provenance: Coordinator web_fetch results inspected directly during execution360. Public lexical evidence, not independent reviewer retrieval. Short headings and English paraphrases retained rather than complete copyrighted entries.

sources.heading: てい【亭】［漢字項目］
sources.selectedEvidence: The actual character heading recognizes on テイ and チン. Its meanings distinguish lodging stations, open-sided resting structures, buildings attracting guests for food or entertainment, tall trees in 亭亭, and the exact middle point in 亭午. Its food/entertainment examples include 料亭.
sources.supports: テイ in 料亭 and the restaurant-building meaning. Combined with complete 料亭/りょうてい and independently sourced 料 リョウ, this supports allocation rather than a bare substring inference.
sources.limits: The character's full meanings do not make every compound interchangeable, every building a 亭, or every テイ replaceable with チン. No historical component or phonetic analysis is adopted.

sources.heading: ちん【▽亭】
sources.selectedEvidence: A small building erected on an elevated site or in a garden for viewing or resting, also called あずまや. The entry explicitly identifies the reading as 唐音.
sources.supports: An attested independent 亭/ちん pavilion noun, not an unmatched source-only reading. A recognition disposition can retain this exact example without making it a selected practice question.
sources.limits: Dictionary recognition and the heading marker do not establish measured frequency or by themselves justify a new practice-support article. No claim that all pavilions must have this name.

sources.heading: てい【亭】 and ちん【亭】
sources.selectedEvidence: The separate headings distinguish mansion/residence, garden resting structure, lodging/restaurant, host and historical station senses. The garden-building sense cross-refers to the ちん heading; that heading again defines a small resting/viewing structure in a garden.
sources.supports: The two lexical readings and the need not to reduce every use of 亭 to a present-day restaurant or to treat ちん as a name-only reading.
sources.limits: Historical quotations are evidence of those cited uses, not modern-frequency evidence or a historical derivation of the character's shape. The 字通 section did not return substantive entry text; it is not claimed as inspected historical evidence.

sources.heading: りょう‐ていレウ‥【料亭】
sources.selectedEvidence: A noun for a high-class restaurant chiefly serving Japanese cuisine.
sources.supports: Exact 料亭/りょうてい and a qualified traditional/upscale Japanese restaurant explanation. The full frozen JMdict family independently says traditional Japanese restaurant, especially a luxurious one.
sources.limits: The Digital Daijisen section returned only its attribution, not an entry definition; no fresh Daijisen word-definition inspection is claimed. Historical encyclopedia mentions of Chinese-style banquet restaurants and locally varying legal categories preclude an absolute Japanese-food-only or uniform-facilities rule. No lodging, entertainment, private-room or reservation guarantee is inferred.

limits: No measured frequency ranking, unrestricted substitution, vocabulary level, historical component analysis, native pronunciation or phone acceptance established. Full frozen JMdict/KANJIDIC2 packets remain the exact source records. Proposed practice selection is not installed teaching or independent review.
